Girdhari Lal And 3 Others vs The State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 October, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141992652/
1

G.A. 
 Court No. - 47
 Hon'Ble Rajeev Misra, J. 
Hon'Ble Dr. Ajay Kumar-Ii, J.
Heard Mr. Abhishek Singh, the learned counsel for petitioners and the learned A.G.A. representing State respondents 1, 2 and 3.

Challenge in this Criminal Misc. Writ Petition is to the F.I.R. dated 29.9.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 428 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 507 IPC, Police Station Phoolpur,
District Prayagraj.

On the matter being taken up, the learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection by contending that the present writ petition has been filed after expiry of a period of more than 3 years from the date of F.I.R.
However, the delay/laches in filing the present writ petition have not been sufficiently explained.
The writ petition runs into as many as 20 paragraphs, however, in none of the paragraphs any explanation has come forward explaining the delay/laches in filing the present writ petition.
Since delay/laches in filing the present writ petition have not been explained, therefore, the present writ petition is liable to be dismissed.
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for petitioners could not overcome the same.

Having heard the learned counsel for petitioners, the learned A.G.A. representing respondents 1, 2 and 3 and upon perusal of record, we find that the preliminary objection raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to this writ petition is clearly borne out from the record.
In view of above, present writ petition fails and is liable to be dismissed.
(Dr. Ajay Kumar-II,J.) (Rajeev Misra,J.) October 7, 2025 HSM  Girdhari Lal And 3 Others vs The State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 October, 2025
